dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors using the America the Beautiful pass to access federal recreational lands and waters by motorcycle or private vehicle.
dimensions.evidence: where a National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Pass is used for access to Federal recreational lands and waters

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative clarity on recreation fee coverage for motorcycle riders, saving individual visitors entrance fees.
dimensions.evidence: Pass shall cover the entrance fee and standard amenity recreation fee... for the passholder and any passengers on the motorcycle; and one additional motorcycle

dimensions.assessment: May result in minor reductions in federal recreational fee collections, though no specific fiscal estimates are provided.
Amends administrative guidelines under the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act for interagency pass vehicle coverage.
dimensions.evidence: Section 805(a)(7) of the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act (16 U.S.C. 6804(a)(7)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent administrative rules for federal recreational land entry passes.

missing_information: Projections of the exact revenue impact on federal recreational land fee collections.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill clarifies rules for the America the Beautiful Annual Pass to ensure coverage for a passholder and passengers on a motorcycle plus one additional accompanying motorcycle, while codifying existing policy for noncommercial vehicles.
